findings.title: nutrition_summary divides a nutrition-only numerator by every calendar day in the range and reports the result as a daily average, with no coverage denominator
findings.evidence: roster/health/tools/diet.py:432-444 (SQL requires metadata ? 'estimated_calories' — meals without nutrition are excluded from the numerator), :478 (days = max((end_date - start_date).days, 1)), :480-489 (daily_avg_calories = total_calories / days, same for protein/carbs/fat; only meal_count is returned, never days_with_data or meals_missing_nutrition), :430 (docstring acknowledges 'Meals without nutrition data are excluded')
findings.taxonomy_shape: 4 (an aggregate that denominates nothing) — new instance in the nutrition lane
findings.detail: Because nutrition metadata is optional on meal_log and there is no external nutrition source, real usage yields a handful of annotated meals across a week and a 'daily average calories' figure that understates intake by whatever fraction went unannotated — presented to the owner and to the weekly summary as a measurement. The fix is not a better estimate but an honest coverage statement alongside it.

findings.title: Spec names the google_health tool inventory without its registered prefix
findings.evidence: openspec/specs/butler-health/spec.md:32 names sleep_latest, sleep_history, hr_history, hrv_history, spo2_history, breathing_rate_history, activity_summary, vo2_max_latest; src/butlers/modules/google_health.py:262-520 registers health_sleep_latest, health_sleep_history, health_hr_history, health_hrv_history, health_spo2_history, health_breathing_rate_history, health_activity_summary, health_vo2_max_latest
findings.taxonomy_shape: NEW: name drift in an inventory assertion — a spec scenario that enumerates a tool surface by a name the runtime does not register, so a conformance reader cannot mechanically verify it
findings.detail: Low blast radius on its own, but it is the same spec line that makes eight prompt stubs read as a shipped capability, so both defects should be repaired in one spec pass.

moves.title: Vitals truth spine: deterministic daily rollups, de-stubbed vital tools, and a live measurement vocabulary
moves.why: about/heart-and-soul/vision.md rule 4 ('the daemon is deterministic infrastructure ... Mixing LLM logic into the daemon is a defect' — inverted here: min/max/avg/trend-slope over the owner's vitals are delegated to the session by instruction string) and rule 2 (modules only add tools — this module adds tools that add nothing). Health MANIFESTO 'Measurements ... It keeps the history so you can see the trajectory' and 'Insight: Patterns hide in plain sight'. Owner-visible payoff within a week: the Sunday summary and the morning briefing start naming sleep duration, resting HR, HRV, SpO2, breathing rate and steps with numbers the owner can re-derive; the dashboard stops reporting blood pressure as absent while three readings sit in facts; asking 'how did I sleep this week' returns the same seven-night average twice in a row.
moves.manifesto: roster/health/MANIFESTO.md (Measurements / Insight / Continuity). No amendment needed — this is the manifesto's first promise, unbuilt.
moves.integration_points: New migration health_003 creating health.vitals_daily (metric TEXT, day DATE, n INT, min/max/mean/median NUMERIC, unit TEXT, source TEXT, source_endpoint_identity TEXT, coverage_days INT, computed_at TIMESTAMPTZ, PRIMARY KEY (metric, day)) plus health.sleep_daily (night DATE, session_count, asleep_minutes, efficiency, deep/light/rem/awake minutes, bedtime_local, waketime_local). New deterministic job roster/health/jobs/health_jobs.py::run_vitals_rollup registered in src/butlers/scheduled_jobs.py _DETERMINISTIC_SCHEDULE_JOB_REGISTRY under health (dispatch_mode='job', hourly), with a butler.toml [[butler.schedule]] entry. Rewrite the eight tool bodies in src/butlers/modules/google_health.py:262-520 to read health.vitals_daily / health.sleep_daily via module db.pool and return typed data. Replace roster/health/tools/reports.py:18 VALID_MEASUREMENT_TYPES with the live-registry query already implemented at roster/health/api/router.py:310 (GET /measurements/types), so health_summary and trend_report enumerate what exists. New API GET /api/health/vitals/daily?metric=&since=&until= in roster/health/api/router.py with models in models.py. Spec: openspec/specs/butler-health/spec.md — replace the line-32 inventory assertion with per-tool return-shape scenarios, and add a Vitals Rollup requirement.
moves.behavior_matrix: Happy path: rollup reads measurement_* and sleep_session facts newer than the last computed_at watermark, upserts one row per (metric, day), and each vital tool returns {rows, unit, baseline, coverage} straight from the table. Failure: a metric with zero facts in the window yields no row and the tool returns an explicit empty result naming the metric and the last day with data — never a zero, never a fabricated average; a connector gone stale is reported through the already-shipped expected_signals tri-state (src/butlers/core/expected_signals.py) so an instrument failure never renders as an owner behaviour gap. Concurrency: single-writer (health owns its schema); the upsert is ON CONFLICT (metric, day) DO UPDATE so two overlapping runs converge, and the watermark is advanced only after the transaction commits. Idempotence: recomputing a day is a pure function of the facts in that day, so replay is a no-op; late-arriving facts for an old day are picked up by a bounded 7-day trailing recompute window. Rollback: drop the two tables and revert the tool bodies — the fact store is untouched and remains the sole source of truth, so nothing is lost.
moves.verification: tests/roster/health/test_vitals_rollup.py: (a) seed 14 days of measurement_resting_hr + sleep_session facts, run the job, assert exact per-day mean/min/max and that a second run changes no row (idempotence); (b) assert health_sleep_history(days=7) returns numeric avg_duration_minutes computed by the daemon and that its return dict contains no 'instruction' key — this last assertion is the regression pin against tool-as-prompt reappearing; (c) a contract test that no tool registered by GoogleHealthModule returns a key named 'instruction'; (d) seed only blood_pressure_systolic facts and assert health_summary lists it (proving the frozen-vocabulary fix) while reporting blood_sugar as absent-with-reason; (e) live smoke against the dev stack: GET /api/health/vitals/daily?metric=resting_hr returns 91-sample-consistent days.
moves.slice_plan: S1 migration + rollup job + tests, no consumer changes (dark). S2 de-stub the eight tools against the rollup tables, contract test bans 'instruction' returns. S3 reports.py reads the live type registry; spec amendment for both inventory and return shapes. S4 GET /api/health/vitals/daily + briefing/weekly-summary prompt update to name the new tools.

moves.title: Baseline deviation and sleep debt as standing conditions, not one-shot nudges
moves.why: about/heart-and-soul/vision.md 'Butlers surface timely, relevant insights without being asked'; src/butlers/core/owner_conditions.py:1-35 exists precisely because a cooldown-timed insight 'structurally cannot express still true and still unactioned' — and Health produces zero owner_conditions today (live GET /api/system/conditions shows only infra sources). Health MANIFESTO 'The butler spots trends you'd miss: a symptom that only happens on Mondays, measurements that drift slowly upward'. Owner-visible payoff within a week: 'Resting HR has run 6 bpm above your 60-day baseline for four nights and HRV is at its 10th percentile' and 'you are 4h20m short of your sleep target across the last seven nights, three nights started after 02:00' — persistent on the Standing Conditions panel until it resolves itself, instead of a nudge that re-fires on a timer whether or not anything changed.
moves.manifesto: roster/health/MANIFESTO.md (Insight, Continuity). Touches roster/chronicler/MANIFESTO.md:32 which already claims 'sleep debt building' as a day-close *memory* insight — this move owns the live, forward-looking signal and Chronicler keeps its retrospective distillation; no overlap of writers, and worth one sentence in the health spec to name the boundary.
moves.integration_points: roster/health/jobs/health_jobs.py: new sections consuming health.vitals_daily / health.sleep_daily from move 1 — rolling baseline (trailing 60-day median + MAD per metric, robust to outliers), deviation run-length, and sleep debt vs an owner-declared target (see move 3's intent store; fall back to declaring the target unset rather than assuming 8h). Emit through the switchboard MCP broker reconcile_owner_condition (roster/switchboard/modules/owner_conditions_broker.py:95-120) with source strings 'health:vitals-deviation' and 'health:sleep-debt' per the {origin_butler}:{category} convention (src/butlers/core/owner_conditions.py source naming section), keeping delivery on the existing propose_insight_candidate path. Add highlights to src/butlers/jobs/briefing.py::run_health_briefing_contribution (currently only missed doses + weight, :262-360). New context producer in src/butlers/jobs/context_producers.py: replace the policy-window-derived 'sleeping' (:38-40, :398-430) with a measured sleep signal that falls back to the quiet-hours window and *labels* the fallback, and add a 'recovering' signal derived from sleep debt + recovery_state. Spec: openspec/specs/butler-health/spec.md insight requirement (:157, :218) gains baseline-deviation and sleep-debt scenarios.
moves.behavior_matrix: Happy path: a metric whose last N days sit outside baseline ± k·MAD for >= 3 consecutive days opens a 'health:vitals-deviation:{metric}' owner condition; it auto-resolves by omission from the next complete snapshot when the metric returns inside the band. Failure: fewer than 30 baseline days, or an unmeasurable producer per expected_signals, opens nothing and records why — a cold-start instrument must never read as a physiological deviation. Concurrency: reconcile_owner_condition is a snapshot reconcile, so a duplicate run in the same window is absorbed; the context producer upserts with a bounded TTL so a crashed producer expires rather than pinning 'recovering' forever (the discipline already documented at context_producers.py:14-19). Idempotence: level-triggered — the same open condition re-confirms rather than re-notifying; delivery is gated on transitions (opened / reopened / escalation_due), not on cooldown expiry. Rollback: stop the job; open conditions auto-resolve by omission and the context signals expire on their TTL, leaving no residue.
moves.verification: tests/roster/health/test_vitals_deviation.py: (a) 60 days of stable resting_hr then 4 days at +8 bpm opens exactly one condition with the expected fingerprint; day 5 back in band resolves it by omission; (b) 20 days of history opens nothing and returns reason='insufficient_baseline'; (c) an expected_signals UNMEASURABLE producer opens nothing (pins the failure-never-impersonates-health rule); (d) sleep-debt math against a seeded target with three short nights, asserting the reported deficit equals the summed shortfall exactly; (e) context test: with a real sleep_session covering now, the measured signal is asserted and its provenance field says 'measured'; with no session, the quiet-hours fallback is asserted and provenance says 'policy_window'.
moves.slice_plan: S1 baseline + deviation conditions behind the existing insight verbosity gate. S2 sleep debt (requires move 3's target, or reports 'target unset'). S3 briefing highlights. S4 measured sleeping/recovering context producer with labelled fallback.

moves.title: Standing health intents: condition watch bands and owner goals as first-class, reviewable objects
moves.why: about/heart-and-soul/vision.md rule 6 ('the conceptual frameworks it uses to structure and prioritize knowledge within its domain ... the document is binding'). Today a condition is an inert label — roster/health/tools/conditions.py:63-121 stores only name/status/diagnosed_at/notes, and grep finds no target range, band or goal anywhere in roster/health — while the live stack holds an active severe aortic-regurgitation diagnosis alongside 91 resting-HR, 83 HRV, 76 SpO2 and 82 breathing-rate readings that the condition does not cause anyone to watch. Health MANIFESTO 'Conditions: the active health issues you're managing, and how they're progressing. It holds the context so you don't have to' and 'Start Small ... Maybe it's your weight, your medications, or your mood'. Owner-visible payoff within a week: the owner says 'watch my resting HR and breathing rate for the valve, flag anything above 70 sustained' or 'I want 8k steps a day this quarter', and from then on every health claim the butler makes is anchored to a named intent the owner authored — and the butler can finally answer 'what are you watching, and why'.
moves.manifesto: roster/health/MANIFESTO.md (Conditions, Agency, Start Small). No amendment needed; the 'A Companion, Not a Doctor' clause is load-bearing for the design — bands are owner- or provider-authored with a recorded origin, never derived by the butler, and the butler never proposes a clinical threshold of its own.
moves.integration_points: Predicate-first (no new table): register 'health_intent' in a new memory migration under src/butlers/modules/memory/migrations/ alongside the health block at 002_seed_predicates.py:871-990 — a property fact with metadata {origin: owner_goal|condition_watch|provider_instruction, condition_id?, metric, direction: below|above|within|trend, target/band, horizon, review_cadence_days, authored_at, authored_by}. New MCP tools in roster/health/tools/conditions.py + registration in roster/health/modules/tools.py: health_intent_set / health_intent_list / health_intent_review / health_intent_close, exposed under a new 'intents' tool group. API: GET/POST/PUT /api/health/intents and GET /api/health/conditions/{id}/intents in roster/health/api/router.py (models in models.py). Consumers: move 2's deviation scan prefers an intent band over a statistical baseline when one exists; move 1's vitals rollup records which metrics are under intent; the insight candidate metadata carries intent_id so the Health page can link the claim to its reason (reusing the typed-door pattern at roster/health/jobs/health_jobs.py:205-231). Spec: new requirement 'Standing health intents' in openspec/specs/butler-health/spec.md.
moves.behavior_matrix: Happy path: setting an intent supersedes any prior intent for the same (metric, origin, condition) pair via the existing property-fact supersession, and the next insight scan evaluates readings against the band, citing the intent. Failure: an intent naming a metric with no data returns accepted-but-unmeasurable and shows on the review surface as 'watching, no instrument' rather than silently never firing; an intent whose review_cadence has lapsed surfaces a review prompt instead of continuing to assert a possibly-stale band. Concurrency: property-fact supersession with expected_supersedes_id (src/butlers/modules/memory/storage.py:1440-1450) gives optimistic concurrency, so two simultaneous edits cannot silently clobber. Idempotence: setting the identical band twice supersedes to an identical fact and changes no downstream behaviour. Rollback: intents are facts — retract them and every consumer falls back to the statistical baseline from move 2; no schema to unwind.
moves.verification: tests/roster/health/test_health_intents.py: (a) an owner band of resting_hr above 70 fires a deviation candidate whose metadata.intent_id matches and whose message cites the owner's own words, and the same reading with no intent falls back to the baseline path; (b) an intent for a metric with zero facts yields state 'unmeasurable' and no candidate; (c) lapsed review_cadence surfaces exactly one review item and suppresses band assertions until reviewed; (d) supersession test: two concurrent health_intent_set calls, one fails with StaleSupersessionTargetError and no fact is written; (e) contract test that the butler cannot author an intent with origin='provider_instruction' without an authored_by value (companion-not-a-doctor pin).
moves.slice_plan: S1 predicate + tools + tests (write side only). S2 deviation scan prefers intent bands, insight metadata carries intent_id. S3 API + Health page 'what I'm watching, and why' index. S4 review cadence and lapse handling.

moves.title: Consultation dossier: the appointment arrives already prepared, with the owner's own accumulated questions
moves.why: roster/health/MANIFESTO.md is explicit: 'Continuity: Health decisions happen across seasons. Your doctor asks, "How have you been feeling?" The Health Butler has the answer: not a vague memory, but the data. This is power.' — and nothing in the repo builds it. src/butlers/jobs/calendar_prep.py:1-58 already establishes the deterministic, zero-LLM prep-rail pattern (RFC-0020: prep MUST read a precomputed contribution path, never a per-open LLM session or cross-schema SELECT) with producers for relationship, email, messenger and travel — Health, which owns the data a clinical visit needs, has no producer. Meanwhile src/butlers/jobs/calendar_overlay.py:876-889 reads an 'appointment' predicate with no writer. Owner-visible payoff within a week: opening Thursday's cardiology follow-up in the calendar workspace shows the interval since the last visit, what moved in the watched metrics since then, the symptom log for that interval, adherence, the three questions the owner asked the butler to remember, and the saved research — one screen, printable, no session spawned.
moves.manifesto: roster/health/MANIFESTO.md (Continuity, Insight, 'A Companion, Not a Doctor' — the dossier presents the owner's own data and questions and makes no clinical assertion). Respects roster/chronicler/MANIFESTO.md ('I do not plan, I do not nudge') by keeping the forward-looking artifact on Health, not Chronicler.
moves.integration_points: New producer src/butlers/jobs/calendar_prep.py::run_health_calendar_prep_contribution, registered in src/butlers/scheduled_jobs.py under health with a butler.toml schedule entry, writing state key calendar/prep/<event_id> (PREP_KEY_PREFIX at calendar_prep.py:81) merged by the existing cross-schema view calendar.v_prep_contributions (migration core_142) and read by GET /api/calendar/workspace/prep/{event_id} — no new read path. Clinical-event classification is deterministic: an owner-maintained provider list (new 'care_provider' predicate, or reuse public.entities with a provider role) matched against event attendees/location/title, never an LLM guess. New 'health_question' temporal-fact predicate plus question_add / question_list / question_close MCP tools in a new roster/health/tools/questions.py so a question captured on any channel ('ask the cardiologist whether I can fly long-haul') lands in the dossier. Dossier body reads health.vitals_daily (move 1), intents (move 3), symptom facts, adherence (move 5's honest denominator), research facts, and the last dossier's date as the interval anchor. Retire the dead appointment lane in calendar_overlay.py:876-889 in the same change. Spec: new requirement in openspec/specs/butler-health/spec.md plus a scenario in the calendar-prep spec naming health as a prep contributor.
moves.behavior_matrix: Happy path: a calendar event classified clinical within the lookahead window gets one envelope per event, upserted via state_set, pruned by the existing prune_old_prep_contributions (calendar_prep.py:188) when the event disappears. Failure: an event that cannot be classified produces no envelope (the prep rail simply shows no health contribution) rather than guessing that a dentist appointment is a cardiology follow-up; a metric with no data in the interval renders 'no readings in this interval' with the last known date, never an interpolated delta; if the previous-visit anchor is unknown the dossier says 'first recorded visit' instead of computing a since-delta from nothing. Concurrency: single writer per event key; state_set upserts, so overlapping runs converge. Idempotence: the envelope is a pure function of (event, facts as of now); recomputing rewrites identical content, and questions already marked closed are excluded so a re-run cannot resurrect them. Rollback: delete the calendar/prep/* keys for health and drop the producer registration; the view degrades to the other contributors exactly as before.
moves.verification: tests/jobs/test_health_calendar_prep.py: (a) seed a clinical event plus interval symptoms, vitals days, two open questions and one closed one — assert the envelope's since-anchor equals the prior clinical event date, the deltas equal hand-computed values, and the closed question is absent; (b) a non-clinical event produces no envelope; (c) zero readings in the interval renders the explicit no-readings string and the last-known date, asserted by exact string so a future refactor cannot substitute a zero; (d) prune test: removing the event removes the key; (e) an architecture/contract test that the producer performs no LLM call and no read outside health.* / public.* (mirrors the existing RFC-0020 discipline); (f) live read-only check that GET /api/calendar/workspace/prep/{event_id} merges the health contribution alongside relationship's.
moves.slice_plan: S1 health_question predicate + tools (immediately useful alone: 'remember to ask the cardiologist about flying'). S2 provider list + deterministic clinical classification + envelope with interval symptoms/adherence/questions. S3 vitals deltas and intent citations once moves 1 and 3 land. S4 retire the dead appointment lane; add a printable dossier view on the Health page.

moves.title: Medication supply ledger and an honest refill door replacing the invented 30-day supply
moves.why: roster/health/jobs/health_jobs.py:522-537 fabricates the supply figure the alert is built on, and :549-556 sets the critical candidate's expires_at to now — the single most actionable health nudge in the system is built on an invented number and expires on arrival. Health MANIFESTO 'Medications: What you take, how often, and whether you're staying on track. It knows that adherence is hard, and helps you understand your real patterns' — 'real' is the operative word. about/heart-and-soul/vision.md 'The bar is reliability, not novelty'. Owner-visible payoff within a week: recording a dispense ('30 tablets, picked up Tuesday, 2 refills left') yields a refill warning that names a real date and, at the door, offers a drafted pharmacy message and a calendar reminder — and when no dispense was ever recorded, the butler says it cannot estimate supply instead of guessing.
moves.manifesto: roster/health/MANIFESTO.md (Medications, Agency). No amendment needed. The refill door's outbound leg respects roster/messenger/MANIFESTO.md as the delivery plane — Health composes, Messenger delivers.
moves.integration_points: Extend the 'medication' property fact's metadata contract with a supply block, and add a 'medication_dispense' temporal-fact predicate (quantity, unit, dispensed_at, days_supply, refills_remaining, pharmacy_entity_id, prescriber_entity_id) seeded alongside the health block in a new memory migration. New tools medication_dispense_record / medication_supply_status in roster/health/tools/medications.py + registration in roster/health/modules/tools.py. Rewrite the refill section at roster/health/jobs/health_jobs.py:456-559 to compute remaining = last dispense quantity − non-skipped doses since dispensed_at, and to register an expectation via src/butlers/core/expected_signals.py so 'no dispense on record' becomes an explicit unmeasurable state that suppresses the nudge (the shipped honest-absence primitive, already used for measurement gaps at health_jobs.py:395-419). Fix expires_at to a horizon independent of days_remaining. Open a 'health:medication-refill' owner condition via reconcile_owner_condition so 'still needed, still unactioned' is durable. Door: insight metadata carries a typed refill door (same pattern as _measurement_door_metadata at health_jobs.py:205-231) offering a Messenger-delivered pharmacy draft on the existing approval spine and a calendar reminder. Also clip the adherence-route denominator (roster/health/api/router.py:806-818) to the medication's own existence window and switch trend_report (roster/health/tools/reports.py:180-188) onto the shared expected-dose denominator so all three surfaces agree. Spec: openspec/specs/butler-health/spec.md:188-194 refill scenario rewritten from 'dose logging frequency suggests' to dispensed-quantity arithmetic with an unmeasurable branch.
moves.behavior_matrix: Happy path: a recorded dispense of 30 tablets at 1/day with 22 non-skipped doses since yields 8 days remaining, one warning candidate with a real depletion date, a durable owner condition, and a refill door. Failure: no dispense on record → expected_signals reports unmeasurable, no candidate, and the medication shows on the Health page as 'supply unknown — record a dispense' (absence stated, never estimated); a dispense older than its days_supply plus a grace window is treated as exhausted-and-unknown, not as negative supply. Concurrency: dispense facts are temporal with idempotency keys, so a double-recorded pickup collapses to one fact; the owner condition reconcile absorbs overlapping scans. Idempotence: the refill dedup_key stays health:medication-refill:{med_id} so re-scans re-confirm rather than re-notify; the door's outbound draft goes through the existing approval spine, so pressing it twice cannot send twice. Rollback: revert the job section and the tools; the fabricated estimate is not restored (it should not be), and medications keep working with 'supply unknown'.
moves.verification: tests/roster/health/test_medication_refill.py: (a) the current fabrication is pinned as a *failing* test first — a 30-day faithful dose history must NOT produce a critical candidate; (b) dispense 30 @ 1/day − 22 doses → days_remaining == 8 exactly and expires_at > now by the configured horizon (regression pin against the self-expiring alarm); (c) no dispense → zero candidates and expected_signals state UNMEASURABLE; (d) denominator agreement test asserting trend_report, GET /medications/{id}/adherence and the insight dip ratio return the same expected-dose count for the same medication and window, and that a medication created 3 days ago is not reported at 10% over a 30-day window; (e) door test: the refill door payload validates against the approval spine's schema and a double-press produces one pending action.
moves.slice_plan: S1 failing test pinning the fabrication, then dispense predicate + tools. S2 rewrite the refill computation with the unmeasurable branch and fix expires_at. S3 unify the three adherence denominators. S4 owner condition + refill door (Messenger draft, calendar reminder).

moves.title: Health fact metadata contract: a privacy class that is actually set, and an assertion strength that carries the hedge
moves.why: The mechanism to keep intimate health content out of the fleet-shared catalog is built and unused: src/butlers/modules/memory/storage.py:61-100 excludes confidential/pii at write time, yet no health write path sets sensitivity (only wellness_ingest.py:519,692, both hardcoding 'normal'), so live catalog search returns the owner's aortic-valve diagnosis, symptom rows, and a third party's rectal-bleeding note. Separately, a symptom inferred from chat is stored at confidence 1.0 with its hedge stranded in prose notes and then counted as an equal vote in trend insights and in the recovery_state advisory. roster/health/MANIFESTO.md: 'Agency: Your health data is yours. You decide what to log, what to share, and what to keep private' and 'There's no judgment in the butler's memory, only honesty.' Owner-visible payoff within a week: the fleet-knowledge search stops returning the owner's diagnosis and symptoms to anything that asks, and every health claim on the dashboard and in the weekly summary is visibly marked measured / owner-said / overheard — so 'you logged snoring three times' stops being said about a sentence the owner never confirmed.
moves.manifesto: roster/health/MANIFESTO.md (Agency, Insight, 'no judgment, only honesty'). The third-party leg also touches roster/relationship/MANIFESTO.md — a contact's health_concern is Relationship-owned; this move sets the class, it does not move the data.
moves.integration_points: Slice A (privacy class): thread sensitivity through every health write — roster/health/tools/conditions.py (condition_add/update, symptom_log/update), medications.py, measurements.py, diet.py, research.py — with a per-predicate default map ('confidential' for condition, symptom, medication, medication_dispense, research, health_question; 'normal' for aggregate-safe measurement_* and sleep rollups) plus an owner override, honored by the shipped exclusion at storage.py:93-100 and the read-time ceiling in search.py. Add a one-time reclassification pass so already-catalogued health rows are purged from public.memory_catalog (the supersession cascade path at storage.py:2003 already knows how to mark catalog entries stale). Same default map applied to relationship's health_concern predicate. Slice B (assertion strength): add assertion (device_measured | owner_reported | provider_reported | inferred_from_conversation) and a real confidence to the health fact metadata contract; add the parameter to symptom_log / measurement_log / condition_add signatures in roster/health/modules/tools.py; make roster/health/jobs/health_jobs.py:568-586 weight or exclude inferred rows in symptom-trend counting and in compute_recovery_state (:124-152), and carry the assertion into the insight message wording. Surface it as a provenance chip on the Health record surfaces (frontend/src/pages/HealthOverviewPage.tsx and the record pages) reusing the existing absent-renders-em-dash discipline. Spec: openspec/specs/butler-health/spec.md gains a 'Health fact privacy and assertion contract' requirement; docs/concepts/identity-model.md and docs/modules/memory.md note the health default map.
moves.behavior_matrix: Happy path: condition_add writes sensitivity='confidential' and the catalog write-behind is skipped (already logged at storage.py:425); an owner-reported symptom writes assertion='owner_reported' and counts fully in trends; an inferred one writes assertion='inferred_from_conversation' with confidence < 1 and is reported separately ('one mention overheard, unconfirmed'). Failure: a write omitting assertion defaults to the least-authoritative value the caller can justify (inferred for conversational ingest paths, device_measured only for connector envelopes), so an un-migrated caller cannot accidentally manufacture authority; if the reclassification purge fails partway it is resumable and idempotent, and until it completes the catalog read ceiling still applies. Concurrency: reclassification runs as a bounded batch job with a watermark; concurrent new writes already carry the right class, so the two cannot fight. Idempotence: setting the same class twice is a no-op; the purge is keyed on (source_schema, source_table, source_id). Rollback: the class defaults are one map — reverting restores the previous (leaky) behaviour, and no canonical fact is altered by either slice, only its metadata.
moves.verification: tests/modules/memory/test_health_catalog_privacy.py: (a) condition_add / symptom_log / medication_add followed by an assertion that public.memory_catalog contains no row for that fact id — the direct inverse of the live leak reproduced today; (b) a measurement_weight write DOES appear (proving the class is discriminating, not blanket); (c) reclassification job over a seeded leaky catalog removes exactly the confidential rows and is idempotent on re-run; (d) tests/roster/health/test_assertion_strength.py: three symptom rows, one inferred, assert the symptom-trend candidate reports two confirmed plus one unconfirmed and that compute_recovery_state ignores the inferred row; (e) a live read-only re-check after landing: GET /api/memory/catalog/search?query=aortic+valve+regurgitation returns no health-scoped fact.
moves.slice_plan: S1 per-predicate default map + thread sensitivity through health writes (new writes stop leaking immediately). S2 reclassification purge of existing catalog rows, including relationship's health_concern. S3 assertion + confidence on the write signatures with least-authoritative defaults. S4 trend/recovery-state weighting and the dashboard provenance chip.

moves.title: Care constraints as fleet-checkable verdicts, and recovery_state with a door
moves.why: The system already holds a real care constraint — live catalog search returns the health rule 'Before accepting or booking a treadmill stress test, obtain cardiology or provider clearance given the owner's active bicuspid aortic valve disease with severe aortic regurgitation and prior valve surgery' — as free prose in health.rules that no butler consults at decision time; and the one derived advisory Health does publish, health.recovery_state, declares permitted_subscribers = [] against a bus that rejects unlisted subscribers (roster/health/domain_events.toml:16; src/butlers/core/domain_event_contracts.py:358-359). about/heart-and-soul/vision.md rule 3 (MCP-only through the Switchboard) and the shipped privacy-minimized precedent medication_travel_snapshot (openspec/changes/add-health-medication-travel-mcp/proposal.md) give the exact pattern. Owner-visible payoff within a week: the fleet stops proposing things the owner's cardiologist ruled out — Lifestyle does not suggest a hard interval session while recovery is depleted, Travel flags a long-haul itinerary for clearance, General does not silently accept a stress-test invite — and none of those butlers ever learn the diagnosis.
moves.manifesto: roster/health/MANIFESTO.md ('A Companion, Not a Doctor' — constraints are owner- or provider-authored and Health only relays them, never authors a clinical rule) plus the binding manifestos of the consumers: roster/travel, roster/lifestyle, roster/general. Implies one amendment: roster/health/MANIFESTO.md should state explicitly that Health relays owner/provider-authored care constraints to the fleet as minimized verdicts, since today the manifesto describes only inward-facing tracking and this move gives Health an outward, consequential voice.
moves.integration_points: New 'care_constraint' property-fact predicate (structured: subject_class in {physical_exertion, air_travel, altitude, scheduling_load, diet, medication_interaction}, requirement in {requires_clearance, avoid, notify_first}, severity, condition_id, authored_by, valid_until) with tools care_constraint_set / list / close in roster/health/tools/conditions.py and registration in roster/health/modules/tools.py. New narrow MCP provider care_constraint_check(action_class, context) on the medication_travel_snapshot pattern (roster/health/tools/medications.py::medication_travel_snapshot + roster/health/modules/tools.py:112-121): returns {verdict: clear | requires_clearance | avoid, requirement, reason_class, constraint_id} and never the diagnosis, symptoms or notes. Consumers reach it through the Switchboard with a cross-butler permission check, mirroring the Travel consumer already built for medications. Wire the check at the consequential seam: the approvals/pending-action path (src/butlers/core/approvals_hooks.py park_pending_action, and the risk map shipped for HA actuation under RFC 0028) so a consequential proposal in a constrained class is parked for owner clearance rather than proposed. Set roster/health/domain_events.toml permitted_subscribers to the butlers whose manifestos own deferral (lifestyle, general, travel) and add reaction handling so 'depleted' actually defers non-essential proposals. Spec: new requirement in openspec/specs/butler-health/spec.md plus consumer scenarios in the travel/lifestyle/general specs; an RFC is warranted for the cross-butler verdict contract given it gates other butlers' actions.
moves.behavior_matrix: Happy path: Lifestyle proposes a hard workout, calls care_constraint_check('physical_exertion'), receives requires_clearance with reason_class 'cardiac' and no diagnosis, and parks the proposal for owner clearance with a plain-language explanation the owner authored. Failure: Health unreachable or the permission absent → the consumer receives an explicit unavailable verdict and must fail *closed* for avoid-class actions and fail *open with disclosure* for notify_first-class ones, never silently proceed as if clear — the distinction is part of the contract, not the caller's discretion. A constraint past valid_until is not returned and is surfaced to the owner for renewal rather than quietly lapsing. Concurrency: constraints are property facts with supersession and optimistic concurrency; the verdict read is stateless. Idempotence: repeated checks are pure reads; a parked proposal is keyed on its own fingerprint so a re-proposal in the same window does not create a second owner decision. Rollback: unset permitted_subscribers and stop registering the provider — consumers fall back to unavailable, which for avoid-class actions means fail-closed, i.e. rollback is conservative by construction.
moves.verification: tests/contracts/test_care_constraint_contract.py: (a) an in-process cross-butler MCP test proving Lifestyle reaches Health through the Switchboard with no health-schema SQL (mirrors the shipped test at openspec/changes/add-health-medication-travel-mcp/tasks.md 3.1); (b) a privacy test asserting the response payload contains no condition name, symptom, note or diagnosis string, by field allowlist; (c) fail-closed test: Health unavailable plus an avoid-class action → the proposal is parked, not proposed; fail-open-with-disclosure for notify_first; (d) an expired constraint is excluded from verdicts and produces exactly one owner renewal item; (e) a domain-event test that a permitted subscriber can now subscribe to health.recovery_state and that an unlisted butler is still rejected — the direct regression pin on the empty-list defect; (f) a reaction test that a 'depleted' state defers a seeded non-essential Lifestyle proposal and does not defer an essential one.
moves.slice_plan: S1 care_constraint predicate + tools, so the owner can author constraints and see them (useful alone). S2 the minimized MCP verdict provider + one consumer (Lifestyle) with the fail-closed/fail-open contract and the privacy allowlist test. S3 recovery_state permitted_subscribers + deferral reaction. S4 wire the check into the approvals/pending-action seam so consequential proposals in constrained classes are parked; RFC for the verdict contract.

audits.jarvis_gap: Today Lifestyle is the most-used butler with the least substrate in the fleet: live `/api/butlers` shows `lifestyle` at 30 sessions/24h (second only to health's 19... in fact the highest of any domain butler), yet it is the only butler with **zero** MCP tools, **zero** API routes, and **zero** domain tables (`roster/lifestyle/tools` absent; `roster/lifestyle/api` absent; `roster/lifestyle/migrations/001_lifestyle_tables.py` is an explicit no-op — "The lifestyle butler has no custom domain tables for v1"). Everything the butler perceives lands as freeform prose in the shared `facts` table under 17 improvised predicates for 61 rows (live census: `listens_to` 22, `plays` 14, `listening_pattern` 6, `listening_session` 5, plus one-off inventions `music_listening`, `music_listening_activity`, `playlist_listening`, `lifestyle_consumption_notes_today`). There is no work/object identity, no rating, no return-rate, no skip/finish signal, no social taste, no place taste, no money-on-media, no persisted digest, and no "tonight" verb. The one dashboard surface that exists renders empty against those 61 facts because it queries `subject: "user"` while 59 of 61 live rows carry entity-resolved subjects. Upstream, the connectors already see everything a taste graph would need and throw it away: the Spotify session tracker is handed `track_id` and artist objects and persists only `track_names: list[str]`, never reads `progress_ms`, so "finished" vs "skipped at twelve seconds" — the single most informative taste signal in existence — is permanently unrecoverable; Steam's achievement, library, and friend pollers are fully implemented and never spawned. Chronicler already projects `listening_episode` and `play_episode` into a 12,467-episode live corpus with exact provenance, and nothing in the taste domain reads a single one of them. The ideal is one hop away from data that already exists; the gap is that the domain that promises "the friend who remembers what you love" has no place to put a love.
audits.ideal: A world-class taste butler holds a **works graph**, not prose: every song, game, film, show, book, restaurant, and place the owner has touched is a resolved object with an external id, and every encounter with it is an append-only typed signal carrying its evidence row — played-to-completion, skipped at 8%, replayed the third time this month, saved, revisited after 14 months, bought and never opened, abandoned at 40% achievements. On top of that ledger sit the owner's own verdicts in the owner's own words, captured from whatever channel they were spoken in, never inferred and never overwritten. Because Chronicler already knows what else was happening, each signal is anchored to the episode it lived inside, so the butler can say "that album is the one you had on the night of the dinner at Koya" and cite both rows. Because Relationship already knows the Dunbar layers, taste is social: the butler knows what the five people closest to the owner signal on, and a gift or an outing is grounded in the friend's recorded evidence rather than a guess. Because Finance already knows the money, the backlog is priced: seven games, $214, three of them played under an hour. And because all of that is ledgered rather than narrated, one keyboard verb — `tonight` — can take the free window until the sleep signal, the company present, the mood the owner names, and the money left, and return three candidates each with its citations and its cost, or refuse honestly when the evidence is too thin to answer. Nothing is recommended by a vendor; every claim is a door onto the signal that produced it.
audits.live_verification: Live (READ-ONLY) against http://127.0.0.1:42200. Stack reachable; all 12 agents `ok`. Confirmed live: (1) `GET /api/butlers` — `lifestyle` port 41109, `sessions_24h: 30`, the highest of any domain butler. (2) `GET /api/memory/facts?subject=user&scope=lifestyle&validity=active&limit=200` → `meta.total = 2`; `GET /api/memory/facts?scope=lifestyle&validity=active&limit=200` → `meta.total = 61`. Subject census over the 61: "Tze How Lee" 47, "Unknown (gaming steam:76561198037633688)" 5, "user" 2, "Unknown sender" 2, "Owner" 1, plus three Spotify-URI subjects. Predicate census: 17 distinct predicates, six of them synonyms for listening. (3) The two `subject=user` rows are both bound to `entity_name: "Unknown (spotify_user_client tzeusii)"` — the owner's own Spotify identity, unresolved. (4) `GET /api/memory/facts?scope=lifestyle...&limit=500` returns HTTP 422 (`limit` clamped ≤ 200), proving the frontend's 200-row page is the hard ceiling. (5) `GET /api/chronicler/episodes?limit=50` → `meta.total = 12467`, including a live `play_episode` ("Played EA SPORTS FC™ 26", `source_ref: connectors.steam_play_history:76561198037633688:3405690:2026-09-05`) and four `listening_episode` rows. (6) `GET /api/chronicler/episodes?episode_type=place_visit` → empty (the place-cluster adapter emits `place_episode`, not `place_visit`; place perception exists but is unpopulated here). (7) `GET /api/memory/facts?scope=relationship&validity=active&limit=200` → `meta.total = 1483`, predicate census contains zero interest/taste predicates on any contact. Statically source-confirmed (read the decisive mechanism, not run): the `ListeningSessionTracker` discard, the `progress_ms` omission, the Steam poller registry, the briefing LIMIT-counts, the frontend predicate selectors, the digest stub, and the `connector-steam` spec self-contradiction.

findings.title: Lifestyle Taste tab queries subject="user" and renders "no taste recorded" while 61 lifestyle facts exist
findings.evidence: frontend/src/components/butler-detail/ButlerLifestyleTasteTab.tsx:355,359,365 (`subject: "user"` on all three queries); live `/api/memory/facts?subject=user&scope=lifestyle&validity=active` → meta.total=2 vs `?scope=lifestyle&validity=active` → meta.total=61; subject census shows 47 rows under "Tze How Lee", 5 under "Unknown (gaming steam:...)", 1 under "Owner"
findings.taxonomy_shape: NEW: identity-key drift — a read surface filters on a literal subject string that the write path stopped producing, so the page reports absence with full authority while the data sits one column value away
findings.detail: The only dashboard surface Lifestyle has hard-codes the legacy `subject="user"` contract from `roster/lifestyle/.agents/skills/memory-taxonomy/SKILL.md` ("Use `\"user\"` for all personal preference facts"). But `openspec/specs/predicate-taxonomy.md` §1.1 states the opposite as normative — "The string `\"user\"` MUST NOT appear as the primary identifier for any migrated fact" — and the live write path resolves subjects to entity display names. Result: the tab shows "No taste preferences recorded yet.", "No active consumption tracked.", "No facts logged yet.", and 0/0/0 KPIs, against a butler that has recorded 61 active facts and burned 30 sessions in 24 hours. Emptiness wears current-data authority; the owner reads the taste tab as proof the butler learned nothing.

findings.title: Computed-then-discarded at the listening seam: track_id, artist ids, and progress_ms never reach durable evidence
findings.evidence: src/butlers/connectors/spotify.py:256 (`track_names: list[str]` is the only track field on `ListeningSession`), :302/:345/:366 (`track_id` used solely for same-track dedup then dropped), :344/:369/:387 (only `track_name` accumulated), :2054 (`artist_names` extracted), :773-784 (artist names consumed only into a narrative string), :1758 (`/me/player/currently-playing` called; `progress_ms` never read anywhere in the file); alembic/versions/core/core_079_spotify_listening_sessions.py:~95-108 (durable table stores `track_names JSONB` text array, no uris)
findings.taxonomy_shape: 1 — computed-then-discarded truth, at the one seam where the discard is irreversible
findings.detail: The connector polls `currently-playing` at active cadence and is handed the full Spotify track object: `id`, `uri`, `artists[].id`, `album`, `duration_ms`, and `progress_ms`. It keeps the display name. `duration_ms` is read at :2055 and used only for a `context_start` narrative payload; `artist_names` is joined into prose at :773; `track_id` is a dedup key. The long-retention evidence table (core_079, explicitly "persists indefinitely") therefore holds a text array of song titles. Three consequences, all permanent for history already collected: (a) no work identity — "Luck Runs Out" cannot be joined to an artist, album, or any external catalog; (b) no completion signal — without `progress_ms` vs `duration_ms` the system cannot distinguish a track the owner finished from one they killed at eight seconds, which is the primary taste primitive; (c) Chronicler's deferred per-track projection (bu-pa4e0.10) is not deferred by choice, it is impossible from the stored evidence. Every question in this lens's pursuit statement is unanswerable because of this one field choice.

findings.title: Taste-tab KPIs are page counts over a 200-row window with has_more discarded
findings.evidence: frontend/src/hooks/use-memory.ts:465 (`limit = 200` default), :475 (`getFacts({..., limit})`), :476 (`return res.data ?? []` — `meta` dropped); frontend/src/components/butler-detail/ButlerLifestyleTasteTab.tsx:38-41,367-369 (all three KPIs are `.length` over that page); live: `limit=500` → HTTP 422 `Input should be less than or equal to 200`
findings.taxonomy_shape: NEW: aggregate that denominates a page — a count rendered as a total is bounded by an API page ceiling the caller cannot raise and does not disclose
findings.detail: `useButlerFacts` returns `res.data` and throws away the `meta` envelope that carries `total`, `limit`, and `has_more` (live response confirms all three are present). "Active preferences", "Currently consuming", and "Recently logged" are therefore `.length` over at most 200 rows, with the server hard-capping `limit` at 200 so no client can widen the window. Once the owner's lifestyle facts pass 200 — the intended steady state for a butler running 30 sessions/day — every KPI silently freezes below truth with no truncation plaque, and "Recently logged (7d)" becomes arbitrary because the 200-row page is ordered by the API, not by recency-within-window.

findings.title: Frontend preference/consumption selectors exclude the majority of the declared taxonomy
findings.evidence: frontend/src/components/butler-detail/ButlerLifestyleTasteTab.tsx:54 (`facts.filter((f) => f.predicate.startsWith("likes_"))`), :57 (`new Set(["watches", "reads", "plays"])`); roster/lifestyle/.agents/skills/memory-taxonomy/SKILL.md (9 stable taste predicates, 4 consumption predicates); live predicate census: `listens_to` is the highest-volume lifestyle predicate at 22 of 61 rows
findings.taxonomy_shape: 2 — a gate that is metadata: the taxonomy is a prose skill file, so every consumer re-guesses it and each guess is wrong differently
findings.detail: "Active preferences" counts only `likes_genre`/`likes_artist`/`likes_cuisine`, silently excluding six of the nine declared stable taste predicates — `favorite_restaurant`, `favorite_recipe`, `hobby`, `food_preference`, `food_dislike`, `routine`. That means every restaurant, recipe, hobby, allergy, and routine the butler has learned is invisible on the panel labelled "Taste summary". "Currently consuming" omits `listens_to`, which live is the single most populated predicate in the schema (22 rows). Both KPI labels denominate a proper subset of what they name, and the shortfall is not disclosed.

findings.title: Briefing summary counts denominate LIMIT clauses, in two butlers
findings.evidence: src/butlers/jobs/briefing.py:1623 (`LIMIT 10`) → :1687 (`f"{len(transient_rows)} new consumption note(s) today."`); :1657 (`LIMIT 5`) → :1689 (`f"{len(durable_rows)} taste preference(s) captured today."`); same shape in Relationship: :827 (`LIMIT 10`) → :892 (`f"{len(birthday_rows)} birthday(s) in next 7 days."`), :873 (`LIMIT 5`) → :898 (`f"{len(gap_rows)} contact(s) overdue for check-in."`)
findings.taxonomy_shape: NEW: aggregate that denominates a LIMIT — a count derived from a row-capped highlight query is spoken to the owner as a period total
findings.detail: The lifestyle briefing contribution fetches at most 10 consumption rows and 5 taste rows purely to build highlight cards, then reports `len()` of those capped fetches as the day's totals. Forty consumption notes read out as "10 new consumption note(s) today"; six new taste preferences read out as "5 taste preference(s) captured today". The same pattern is in the Relationship contribution, where "N birthday(s) in next 7 days" saturates at 10 and "N contact(s) overdue for check-in" saturates at 5 — a ceiling the owner would read as good news. Correct form is a separate `COUNT(*)` for the summary, independent of the highlight LIMIT.

findings.title: Three divergent predicate allowlists for one taxonomy, and the registry enforces none of them
findings.evidence: roster/lifestyle/.agents/skills/memory-taxonomy/SKILL.md (13 predicates); src/butlers/jobs/briefing.py:1625 (4 transient) and :1660-1668 (7 durable — omits `favorite_recipe` and `routine`); frontend/src/components/butler-detail/ButlerLifestyleTasteTab.tsx:54,57; src/butlers/modules/memory/storage.py:1610 (`_predicate_is_novel = _registry_row is None`) and :1679-1680 (novel predicates get advisory fuzzy suggestions, never rejection); `grep -rn 'listens_to|likes_genre|favorite_restaurant' alembic/versions/` → no hits (no lifestyle predicate is seeded into `predicate_registry`)
findings.taxonomy_shape: 3 — built thrice, unified never; plus a gate that is advice
findings.detail: Because no lifestyle predicate is registered, `memory_store_fact` accepts anything with a soft fuzzy-match hint. The live consequence is 17 distinct predicates over 61 rows with six mutually-unaware synonyms for the same concept — `listens_to`(22), `listening_pattern`(6), `listening_session`(5), `music_listening_activity`(1), `music_listening`(1), `playlist_listening`(1) — plus one-offs the LLM invented on the spot (`lifestyle_consumption_notes_today`, `consumption_note`, `gaming_activity`, `scheduled_activity`, `cleaning_appointment`, `receives_marketing`). Each of the three consumer allowlists then matches a different slice, so no two surfaces agree on what the owner's taste is, and any aggregate over the domain is arithmetic over an unstable vocabulary.

findings.title: Weekly digest archive is a decorative panel that can never fill, and a KPI cell hard-codes an em dash
findings.evidence: frontend/src/components/butler-detail/ButlerLifestyleTasteTab.tsx:335-340 (`function WeeklyDigestArchivePanel()` takes no props, has no data source, unconditionally renders "No weekly digests yet."), :158-163 (fourth KPI cell hard-codes `value="—"` / `sub="no digest history"`), :443-448 (the panel occupies half of layout row 3); roster/lifestyle/butler.toml `weekly-taste-digest` schedule delivers via `notify(channel="telegram")` only, with no persistence step
findings.taxonomy_shape: NEW: decorative chrome — a titled card and a KPI slot wired to nothing, shipped as if a data path existed and merely happened to be empty
findings.detail: A quarter of the KPI strip and a quarter of the panel grid are structurally incapable of carrying information: the archive component has no query, no props, no hook, and the KPI value is a literal. The tab's own header comment admits it ("Weekly digest archive: stub — no historical digest storage exists yet"), but the rendered page does not — it presents as a live archive that is currently empty, which is indistinguishable to the owner from a butler that has never sent a digest. Meanwhile the digests genuinely do go out weekly over Telegram and are then unrecoverable: the sole artifact of the butler's signature ritual is a chat message with no row behind it.

findings.title: connector-steam spec carries normative SHALL scenarios that no code path can satisfy
findings.evidence: openspec/specs/connector-steam/spec.md § "Delta Detection via State Diffing" — scenarios "Achievement unlock detection", "Game purchase detection", "Friend list change detection", "Tracked games for achievement polling" (all `SHALL`), contradicted in the same file by § "Polling Modes and Intervals" → "Default poll intervals" ("achievement, friend list, and game library data SHALL NOT be polled in the background"); src/butlers/connectors/steam.py:86-95 (`_DEFAULT_INTERVALS` holds only `recently_played` and `online_status`), :865 (`for data_type in _DEFAULT_INTERVALS:` is the sole task-spawn loop), :900-904 (`_poll_achievements`/`_poll_friends`/`_poll_game_library` present in the dispatch dict but unreachable), :656 (`build_game_purchase_envelope` dead), :1511 (`_poll_game_library` dead)
findings.taxonomy_shape: NEW: spec that contradicts itself in normative voice — two SHALL clauses in one document mandate and forbid the same behavior, so the spec cannot be used to judge the code
findings.detail: `_filtered_bufs` at :847-853 is likewise built over `_DEFAULT_INTERVALS`, so even a manual task spawn would find no buffer. Four normative scenarios are unimplementable by construction while reading as requirements, which means the spec cannot answer "does the code match?" for a third of this connector's stated perception. Separately, this is where the taste lens loses its two best gaming signals: achievement progress (the completion/abandonment signal) and library additions (the purchase signal that would let Finance price the backlog). They were dropped as "noise" against a session-tracking goal, which was correct for that goal and is exactly wrong for a taste domain.

findings.title: The owner's own connector personas are never bound to the owner entity, splitting every taste aggregate across four subject labels
findings.evidence: live `/api/memory/facts?subject=user&scope=lifestyle&validity=active` — both rows carry `entity_id: 9dffc07b-686d-4669-84a4-8faad33cdb2e`, `entity_name: "Unknown (spotify_user_client tzeusii)"`; live subject census over the 61 active lifestyle facts: "Tze How Lee" 47, "Unknown (gaming steam:76561198037633688)" 5, "user" 2, "Owner" 1; openspec/specs/predicate-taxonomy.md §1.3 "Owner Entity Bootstrap" (`SELECT entity_id FROM public.contacts WHERE roles @> '["owner"]'`) is the contract this violates
findings.taxonomy_shape: NEW: endpoint identity never resolved to owner identity — a connector's own account handle becomes an `unidentified` entity that then owns the owner's facts
findings.detail: Two of the owner's Spotify-derived taste facts are pinned to an entity literally named "Unknown (spotify_user_client tzeusii)", and five Steam-derived play facts to "Unknown (gaming steam:76561198037633688)", while 47 sit under the resolved owner name and one under the string "Owner". Any "what does the owner like" query must union four labels and two `unidentified` entities to be complete, and no consumer does. The generic merge machinery is already tracked elsewhere; the specific unresolved gap is that connector endpoint identity for the owner's *own* accounts (`spotify_user_client:<handle>`, `steam:<steamid64>`) has no binding step to the owner contact at account-registration time, so each connector manufactures a fresh unidentified persona that then accretes the owner's history.

moves.title: The taste ledger: works, signals, and verdicts as first-class tables (Lifestyle stops storing taste as prose)
moves.why: `roster/lifestyle/MANIFESTO.md` promises "Memory" ("remembers your preferences without you having to maintain them"), "Pattern" ("notices when your listening habits change... reflects your patterns back to you"), and "the keeper of your taste" — and `openspec/specs/butler-lifestyle/spec.md` § Memory Taxonomy Shape is the only substrate ever specified for it. Lifestyle is the sole butler in the fleet with zero domain tables (`roster/lifestyle/migrations/001_lifestyle_tables.py`: "no custom domain tables for v1"), zero tools, and zero API routes, while running the highest session count of any domain butler (live: 30/24h). vision.md § What Success Looks Like measures "the amount of mental labor the system reliably absorbs"; prose facts under 17 unstable predicates absorb none of it, because nothing can be counted, ranked, or returned to. Owner-visible payoff inside a week: "what have I actually returned to this year, ranked by return-rate, each row a door onto its evidence" — a question that is currently unanswerable and would be answerable the day the backfill lands.
moves.integration_points: New `roster/lifestyle/migrations/002_taste_ledger.py`: `lifestyle.works` (id, kind ∈ {track,album,artist,game,film,show,book,restaurant,place,podcast}, canonical_title, external_ids JSONB with typed keys `spotify:track:*`/`steam:app:*`/`tmdb:*`/`isbn:*`/`google_place:*`, first_seen_at, entity_id FK to `public.entities` for graph participation), `lifestyle.taste_signals` (append-only: work_id, signal_kind ∈ {encounter,complete,skip,replay,save,revisit,abandon,purchase,progress}, strength NUMERIC, observed_at, origin ∈ {connector,owner_asserted,inferred}, source_ref TEXT matching the connector evidence key, context_episode_id, idempotency_key UNIQUE), `lifestyle.taste_verdicts` (work_id, verdict_scale, verdict_text preserving the owner's exact words, asserted_at, supersedes_id — never destructive). New `roster/lifestyle/tools/`: `taste_work_resolve`, `taste_signal_record`, `taste_verdict_set`, `taste_recall(kind, since, order_by ∈ {return_rate,recency,verdict})`, `taste_stats`. New `roster/lifestyle/api/router.py` + `models.py` (auto-discovered by `src/butlers/api/router_discovery.py`, DB deps via `wire_db_dependencies()`): `GET /api/lifestyle/works`, `/api/lifestyle/works/{id}` (detail-page archetype), `/api/lifestyle/taste/summary` with the degraded envelope from `docs/api_and_protocols/response-conventions.md`. Spec: amend `openspec/specs/butler-lifestyle/spec.md` with a Taste Ledger requirement; seed all 13 taxonomy predicates plus the signal kinds into `predicate_registry` so `src/butlers/modules/memory/storage.py:1610` stops auto-registering inventions. Backfill reads `connectors.spotify_listening_sessions`, `connectors.steam_play_history`, and the 61 existing lifestyle facts.
moves.manifesto: Lifestyle (`roster/lifestyle/MANIFESTO.md` — Memory, Pattern, "the keeper of your taste"). No amendment needed: the manifesto already promises this and the code has never had a place to put it. One clarifying clause is worth adding — "we remember works, not sentences" — so the prose-fact regression is contractually closed.
moves.behavior_matrix: Happy path: a Spotify session summary lands → connector evidence row → deterministic resolver upserts one `works` row per track uri and one `taste_signals` row per play, no LLM. Failure: an unresolvable external id yields a `works` row with `external_ids = {}` and `kind` from the source channel, never a dropped signal and never a fabricated id; a resolver outage buffers into the existing replay-queue path rather than losing evidence. Concurrency: `works` unique on `(kind, external_ids->>'primary')` with `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`; `taste_signals` unique on `idempotency_key` so two projector passes over the same evidence row converge. Idempotence: signal keys are `<source_table>:<source_ref>:<signal_kind>`, matching the connector evidence key format already used by core_079, so replays and backfills are no-ops. Rollback: the ledger is derived plus owner assertions — `002` downgrade drops the three tables; owner verdicts are exported to a JSONB column on the legacy fact rows before drop so the only non-derivable data survives a revert.
moves.verification: (1) `roster/lifestyle/tests/test_taste_ledger.py` — backfill over a fixture of three real `connectors.spotify_listening_sessions` rows produces exact expected `works`/`taste_signals` counts, then a second backfill pass over the same rows produces zero new rows (idempotence at the real seam, not a mock). (2) A test asserting every predicate named in `roster/lifestyle/.agents/skills/memory-taxonomy/SKILL.md` exists in `predicate_registry` after migration — the doc and the gate can no longer diverge. (3) `GET /api/lifestyle/taste/summary` against a seeded DB returns `meta.total` from a `COUNT(*)`, and a test asserts the response `total` exceeds the returned page length when >200 works exist (kills the page-count class from findings 3 and 5 at birth). (4) A concurrency test running two projector tasks against one evidence batch and asserting a single signal row per (source_ref, kind).
moves.slice_plan: S1 — migration `002` + resolver + backfill from the two connector evidence tables, zero UI, verified by the idempotence test. S2 — the five MCP tools, so the butler's own sessions write into the ledger instead of inventing predicates; registry seeding lands here and the fuzzy-suggestion path becomes a rejection for lifestyle scope. S3 — `roster/lifestyle/api/router.py` read surface with honest `meta.total` and degraded envelope. S4 — replace the three broken selectors in `ButlerLifestyleTasteTab.tsx` with ledger-backed panels (this simultaneously fixes findings 1, 3, and 4). S5 — one-time migration of the 61 legacy prose facts into verdicts/signals, with the prose preserved as `verdict_text`.

moves.title: Full-fidelity play evidence + the skip/finish signal (stop discarding taste at the connector)
moves.why: `about/heart-and-soul/architecture.md` makes the connector the cost boundary that normalizes external events into durable evidence; `src/butlers/connectors/spotify.py:256` normalizes a rich Spotify track object down to its display string, and `alembic/versions/core/core_079_spotify_listening_sessions.py` then persists that indefinitely as the system's only long-retention listening record. The connector already holds `track_id` (:302), `artists[].id` (:2054), and `duration_ms` (:2055), and already calls the endpoint that returns `progress_ms` (:1758) without reading it. Everything in this lens's pursuit question — return-rate, skip-rate, the artist you go back to, what you played through versus bailed on — is blocked on one field set at one line. Owner-visible payoff inside a week: "you skipped 38% of that playlist and finished every track on this one" and "this is the third time you've come back to that album in six weeks" — sentences the system physically cannot produce today.
moves.integration_points: `src/butlers/connectors/spotify.py`: extend `ListeningSession` (:247-269) and `ListeningSessionTracker.process_playback` (:309) to carry a `tracks: list[TrackObservation]` of (track_uri, artist_uris, album_uri, duration_ms, first_progress_ms, max_progress_ms, first_seen_at, last_seen_at); read `progress_ms` at the `currently-playing` call site (:2006-2060) and at the `recently-played` gap-fill (:1772+, where progress is unavailable — mark those observations `precision='play_only'`, never guess). New migration `core_2xx_spotify_track_plays.py`: `connectors.spotify_track_plays` (idempotency_key UNIQUE `spotify:<endpoint_identity>:play:<track_uri>:<first_seen_ms>`, session_idempotency_key FK to `connectors.spotify_listening_sessions.idempotency_key`, completion_ratio GENERATED, skipped BOOLEAN GENERATED from a spec'd threshold, observation_precision), written by `connector_writer`, granted to `butler_chronicler_rw` and the new `butler_lifestyle_rw` reader per the RFC 0014 §D8 grant discipline core_079 already follows. Keep `spotify_listening_sessions` as the coarse rollup so `src/butlers/chronicler/adapters/spotify.py` and the shipped Music lane are untouched. Spec: amend `openspec/specs/connector-spotify/spec.md` with a Per-Play Evidence requirement stating the skip threshold and the `play_only` precision class.
moves.manifesto: Lifestyle (Pattern: "notices when your listening habits change") and Chronicler (`roster/chronicler/MANIFESTO.md`: "Preserve source provenance on every row: ... how precise the boundary is" — `observation_precision` is exactly that discipline applied one level down). No amendment: this is doctrine already written, applied to a table that skipped it.
moves.behavior_matrix: Happy path: each poll of an active track updates `max_progress_ms` on the open play row; on track change the row closes and `completion_ratio` resolves; skip/finish is derived, never asserted by an LLM. Failure: `progress_ms` absent (204, gap-fill path, or Spotify omission) writes `observation_precision='play_only'` with NULL completion and `skipped = NULL` — honest absence, not a false `false`; the honest-absence vocabulary from `public.expected_signals` is the precedent. A DB write failure follows the existing best-effort evidence path (core_079's pattern) and logs without dropping the session summary. Concurrency: one poller per endpoint identity by construction; the UNIQUE idempotency key makes a restart mid-session converge rather than duplicate. Idempotence: keyed on (endpoint, track_uri, first_seen_ms) so a connector restart that re-observes the same track re-upserts one row and `max_progress_ms` is monotonic via `GREATEST()`. Rollback: additive table plus additive in-memory fields; dropping the table restores exactly today's behavior, and `spotify_listening_sessions` writes are unchanged throughout.
moves.verification: (1) `tests/connectors/test_spotify_track_plays.py` — drive `ListeningSessionTracker` with a scripted poll sequence (track A at 5s then track B) and assert one closed play row with `completion_ratio ≈ 0.02` and `skipped = true`, and a full-duration sequence asserting `skipped = false`; this is the behavior, not a field-presence check. (2) A test that gap-filled plays land with `observation_precision='play_only'` and `skipped IS NULL`, asserting no fabricated completion. (3) A restart test: run the tracker, snapshot, replay the same polls through a fresh tracker, assert row count unchanged and `max_progress_ms` non-decreasing. (4) A grant test in the migration suite asserting `butler_lifestyle_rw` can SELECT and cannot INSERT, mirroring core_079's grant assertions.
moves.slice_plan: S1 — `TrackObservation` + `progress_ms` read + the new table and grants, connector writes it, nothing reads it. S2 — completion/skip derivation with the threshold spec'd and the `play_only` precision class proved by test. S3 — `lifestyle.taste_signals` projector consumes it (joins Move 1), producing `complete`/`skip`/`replay` signals. S4 — optional Chronicler per-track precision upgrade, now actually possible (unblocks bu-pa4e0.10 on evidence rather than on choice).

moves.title: `tonight` — one grounded verb that answers "what should I do with this evening", or refuses honestly
moves.why: `roster/lifestyle/MANIFESTO.md` § Discovery is the butler's only forward-looking promise and today it is a weekly retrospective Telegram message. vision.md § What Success Looks Like requires butlers to "surface timely, relevant insights without being asked". Every input this verb needs is already live and unread: Chronicler's 12,467 episodes including `listening_episode` and `play_episode` (live-confirmed), the context bus signals `socializing`/`at_home`/`sleeping`/`dnd` (`openspec/specs/context-bus/spec.md` § Signal Vocabulary), the calendar module's free-window read, Relationship's Dunbar layers, and Finance's spend surface. Owner-visible payoff inside a week: one keyboard verb or one Telegram line returns three candidates, each with the free window it fits, the company it assumes, the money it costs, and the signals that justify it — and says "I don't have enough evidence about films to answer that" when it doesn't, instead of guessing.
moves.integration_points: New `roster/lifestyle/tools/tonight.py`: `lifestyle_tonight(window_minutes: int | None, company: str | None, mood: str | None, kinds: list[str] | None)`. Reads: `lifestyle.taste_signals`/`works`/`taste_verdicts` (Move 1) for candidates and return-rate; `src/butlers/core_tools` context read for the active signal set (read is unrestricted; no new write permission needed, so the `openspec/specs/context-bus/spec.md` § Write Permissions table is untouched); the calendar module for the gap between now and the `sleeping` signal's onset; `GET /api/chronicler/episodes?episode_type=listening_episode|play_episode` for "how much media time already today" so it can decline to recommend more. Cross-butler: Finance headroom and Relationship company come via `openspec/specs/cross-butler-delegation/spec.md` (Switchboard-brokered, MCP-only per vision.md Rule 3) — never a cross-schema read. Surfaces: the MCP tool for Telegram/dashboard-chat, plus `GET /api/lifestyle/tonight` for a dashboard card and a command-palette verb. Spec: new requirement in `openspec/specs/butler-lifestyle/spec.md` — Tonight Verb, including the mandatory insufficient-evidence branch and the explicit non-scheduling boundary.
moves.manifesto: Lifestyle (Discovery). Boundary discipline is load-bearing: `openspec/specs/butler-lifestyle/spec.md` § Social event planning refusal means `tonight` must **propose** and hand off — if the owner says yes to "dinner with Sam", it delegates the calendar/invite to Relationship over the Switchboard rather than scheduling. Worth one manifesto amendment clause: "we may suggest an evening; we never book one."
moves.behavior_matrix: Happy path: returns ≤3 ranked candidates, each carrying `work`, `fit_minutes`, `citations: [signal_id|episode_id]`, `estimated_cost`, and `company_assumed`. Failure/absence: fewer than a spec'd minimum of signals for a requested kind returns `insufficient_evidence` naming the kind and the count it has, never a vendor recommendation and never a filler suggestion — the `public.expected_signals` unmeasurable-semantics vocabulary is the precedent. Degraded input: an unreachable Chronicler or Finance yields a candidate set flagged `partial` in a degraded envelope listing which input was missing, so a recommendation never impersonates a fully-informed one. Concurrency: pure read verb, no locks, safe to call repeatedly. Idempotence: same inputs plus same ledger state return the same ranking (ranking is deterministic over signals — no LLM in the ranker; the session only narrates the returned rows). Rollback: read-only tool plus one route; removing it changes nothing else.
moves.verification: (1) `roster/lifestyle/tests/test_tonight.py` — seeded ledger with a 20-minute free window returns only candidates whose `fit_minutes <= 20`, and a seeded empty film corpus returns `insufficient_evidence` with the observed count, asserted on the response not the prompt. (2) A degraded test stubbing the Chronicler read as unavailable and asserting `partial` plus the named missing input, per `docs/api_and_protocols/response-conventions.md`. (3) A determinism test: two calls with identical ledger state return byte-identical candidate ordering. (4) A boundary test asserting `lifestyle_tonight` never calls a calendar-write tool, with the handoff proved by an asserted Switchboard delegation call.
moves.slice_plan: S1 — deterministic ranker over the taste ledger with window fit only, plus the `insufficient_evidence` branch, MCP tool only. S2 — context-bus and sleep-window read so the window is derived rather than passed. S3 — media-time-today read from Chronicler so it can say "you've already had four hours of screen time". S4 — Finance headroom and Relationship company via delegation, with `partial` degradation. S5 — dashboard card + palette verb + the propose-then-act handoff to Relationship.

moves.title: Social taste: contact interest facts and a `taste_overlap` door for gifts and outings
moves.why: `roster/relationship/MANIFESTO.md` promises "Track gift ideas as they come to you" and "their interests, preferences, and history with you", and its Dunbar model says "attention flows inward" — yet the live predicate census over 1,483 active relationship facts contains **zero** interest or taste predicates on any contact (only `interaction_*`, `role`, contact-detail, and one-off strings). Meanwhile Lifestyle owns taste and has no read on people at all. So the two manifestos that together promise "the right gift for the person you care about" cannot currently share a single fact. Owner-visible payoff inside a week: "three things Sam has actually signalled interest in, each citing the message where they said it" for a gift, and "the two shows you have both signalled on" for an evening together.
moves.integration_points: Relationship side: register `interest_*`/`avoids_*` predicates in `predicate_registry` and add capture to `roster/relationship/tools/facts.py`/`notes.py` so interaction text yields typed interest facts as **edge facts** — `entity_id = contact`, `object_entity_id = lifestyle.works.entity_id` (Move 1 gives every work an entity), with the source message preserved as evidence via the existing `roster/relationship/tools/fact_evidence.py` path. Lifestyle side: `roster/lifestyle/tools/overlap.py` → `taste_overlap(contact_identifier)` returning shared works, each with the owner's signal strength and the contact's cited interest fact; reached over MCP via the Switchboard, never a cross-schema read (vision.md Rule 3). Relationship side consumer: `roster/relationship/tools/gifts.py` gains a `gift_suggest_grounded` that returns only candidates backed by a cited contact interest fact and refuses when there are none. Surfaces: `GET /api/relationship/contacts/{id}/interests` and a taste-overlap block on `EntityDetailPage`. Spec: new requirement in `openspec/specs/relationship-facts/spec.md` for the interest predicate class and its evidence obligation; a companion requirement in `openspec/specs/butler-lifestyle/spec.md` for the read-only overlap verb.
moves.manifesto: Relationship (Thoughtfulness: gift tracking; Richness: "the small details that make relationships real") and Lifestyle (keeper of taste). Requires one Lifestyle manifesto amendment: today § What This Butler Does Not Do says "It does not plan social events or manage your relationships", which reads as forbidding any read of a person. Amend to distinguish reading a friend's recorded taste (Lifestyle's job) from managing the relationship or scheduling the event (Relationship's job), so the boundary is written rather than inferred by whoever touches it next.
moves.behavior_matrix: Happy path: an interaction mentioning a friend's interest produces one edge fact citing the message; `taste_overlap` returns works both parties signal on. Failure: a contact with no interest facts returns an explicit empty result naming the contact and the zero count, and `gift_suggest_grounded` refuses rather than inventing — an ungrounded gift suggestion is the exact failure this move exists to remove. Ambiguous contact resolution reuses `roster/relationship/tools/resolve.py`'s existing ambiguity return, never a silent first-match. Concurrency: interest facts follow the memory module's existing property-fact supersession (`src/butlers/modules/memory/storage.py:1736+`), so two sessions asserting the same predicate for the same contact supersede rather than duplicate. Idempotence: capture keyed on the source message id, so re-processing an interaction adds nothing. Rollback: predicate registration and two read tools; unregistering leaves existing facts inert but readable, and no contact data is destroyed.
moves.verification: (1) `roster/relationship/tests/test_interest_facts.py` — an interaction fixture yields exactly one edge fact with a non-null evidence reference, and re-processing the same message yields zero new facts. (2) `roster/lifestyle/tests/test_taste_overlap.py` — a seeded contact with two overlapping works returns exactly those two with both sides' citations; a contact with none returns the explicit empty shape, asserted on the payload. (3) A refusal test: `gift_suggest_grounded` on an interest-free contact returns the refusal, and a test asserts no candidate is ever returned without a citation field. (4) A doctrine test asserting the Lifestyle overlap tool reaches Relationship data only via the Switchboard client, never a direct pool query against the relationship schema.
moves.slice_plan: S1 — register the interest predicate class and add capture to Relationship's fact tools with mandatory evidence. S2 — `taste_overlap` read verb over the Switchboard. S3 — `gift_suggest_grounded` with the refusal branch, replacing ungrounded suggestion. S4 — surfaces: contact-page interests block and overlap chips; `tonight(company=<contact>)` from Move 3 starts consuming overlap. S5 — Lifestyle manifesto amendment PR landing the boundary clause.

moves.title: Media-to-memory: a Chronicler co-occurrence projection so a song can be bound to the night it was heard
